The secant function now restricts `upper_limit`, `slope`, and `offset` to the names present in the loss variable. For a network containing branches excluded from that variable, legacy alignment could previously introduce additional branch labels into the constraints; the new selections remove them. This change is independent of flattening snapshots and can occur with the default/`"auto"` or `"multiindex"` setting under legacy semantics.
